title: Dana Point Charters

services.name: Sailboat Racing
services.desc: Not a day goes by when we cannot find some sea life just outside the Dana Point Harbor. This area is well known for countless sightings of blue whales, grey whales and the occasional Orca. We will jump aboard the one of our immaculate sailing vessels for this 3-hour excursion. Depending on the winds, we may put up the sails as we set out to find ourselves some sea life. If whales are being spotted, we usually can see the other whale watching boats packed with a hundred people, as we casually sneak up on your private charter. It’s pretty common we’re able to come across a pod of dolphin, who love to swim right off our bow. You will have the opportunity to sit on the bow and almost touch
